DIRECTION A - NEON RAIN

Six screens in the leading direction: deep blue-black, cyan + magenta, glass panels, scanlines and grain.

Two other directions live on the 'Other directions' page - have a look before we commit.

Placeholders to replace:
- 'NOCTURNE' is a stand-in app name
- posters are abstract art, not real key art
- all counts, scores and match %% are sample data

On the Home artboard the chips above the frame change the accent colour and toggle the scanlines.

TWO ALTERNATIVES

Same Home screen, different stance.

B - ARCHIVE TERMINAL
Wallace-Corp side of Blade Runner: amber on warm black, condensed type, hard rules, data as a ledger rather than posters. Calm and grown-up; less obviously 'sci-fi app'. Trade-off: reads as a database, so browsing by feel is weaker.

C - HAZARD HUD
The Cyberpunk 2077 end: hazard yellow, clipped corners, glitched title, dense HUD chrome. Highest energy and most distinctive. Trade-off: loud, and it will fight the posters once real key art goes in.
